summary: Sets the session-time global dbl_8AFEA0 from the float argument, resets the high-precision performance-counter timer on `this`, performs two index/bounds checks against the data table at 008b8e48, and stores the result of sub_556760(0) into dbl_8AFEA8. Invoked from RunCollisionDetectionLoop, SessionSynchronizer and VidMan_Restart.

local_names.this: timer/timing object whose performance-counter timer is reset
local_names.a2: float session-time value stored to dbl_8AFEA0

operations.description: Store the float argument a2 into the session-time global dbl_8AFEA0
Reset the high-precision performance-counter timer on `this` via TimerResetUsingQueryPerformanceCounter
Bounds/index check 0 against the data table at 008b8e48 via BoundsCheckAgainstDAT008b8e48
Bounds/index check 1 against the data table at 008b8e48 via BoundsCheckAgainstDAT008b8e48
Store the result of sub_556760(0) into the input-axis dead-zone global dbl_8AFEA8
Invoked by RunCollisionDetectionLoop (0045F390) as part of session time/timer initialization
Invoked by SessionSynchronizer (0045F950) to re-initialize session time and the timer together
Invoked by VidMan_Restart (004FA640) to re-initialize the timing state after a video-manager restart
